summary: Guardian liveblog of Game 2 of the 2023 World Series, in which the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Texas Rangers 9-1 behind a dominant start from Merrill Kelly to even the series at 1-1. The game was close until the Rangers bullpen faltered in the late innings, giving Arizona a big eighth and ninth. The series now moves to Arizona for Game 3 on Monday.
one_line: The Diamondbacks beat the Rangers 9-1 in World Series Game 2, led by Merrill Kelly's seven strong innings, to tie the series 1-1.
key_facts: The Arizona Diamondbacks won Game 2 of the 2023 World Series 9-1 over the Texas Rangers, tying the series 1-1.
Merrill Kelly pitched 7.0 IP, allowing 3 H and 1 ER with 7 Ks, and was called the player of the game.
Tyler Kepner noted Kelly was the first pitcher to work seven innings in a World Series game in the 2020s; the last were Stephen Strasburg (8.1 IP) and Gerrit Cole (7 innings twice) in 2019.

Arizona led 4-1 entering the eighth, then scored three runs in the inning off Rangers relievers, including a two-run, two-out single by Ketel Marte that made it 6-1 and an RBI single by Carroll that made it 7-1.
Martín Pérez walked the bases loaded against Perdomo and also walked Emmanuel Rivera, showing poor command in relief.
In the ninth, Rivera hit a two-run single to make it 9-1 but was thrown out at second to end the inning.
Marcus Semien got his first hit of the game, a single in the bottom of the ninth, but Luis Frías closed out the game when Mitch Garver lined out to third.
Andrew Saalfrank relieved Kelly in the eighth and pitched into the ninth for Arizona; Frías got the final outs.
Pham went 4-for-4 on the day, with a single starting the eighth inning.
The first Arizona strikeout of the game came in the eighth, when Chris Stratton struck out Thomas on pitch number nine.
Game 3 is Monday in Arizona, with Max Scherzer (Rangers) and Brandon Pfaadt (Diamondbacks) penciled in as probable starters.
The Rangers needed late-inning drama to win Game 1 in a come-from-behind effort.
